name: Payment Invoices Dashboard
script:
let allInvoices = []; const container = root_element; setTimeout(() => { loadInvoices(); }, 300); async function loadInvoices() { const currentUser = frappe.session.user; const res = await frappe.call({ method: 'frappe.client.get_list', args: { doctype: 'Payment Invoice Details', filters: { email_id: currentUser }, fields: [ 'name', 'invoice_id', 'customer', 'email_id', 'site', 'package_name', 'package_type', 'app_name', 'duration', 'total', 'grand_total_inr', 'discount_amount', 'rounded_total_inr', 'rounding_adjustment_inr', 'creation' ], order_by: 'creation desc', limit_page_length: 100 } }); allInvoices = res.message || []; renderInvoices(allInvoices); } function renderInvoices(invoices) { const content = container.querySelector('#invoice-content'); if (!invoices.length) { content.innerHTML = `
No Invoices Found
`; return; } const html = invoices.map(inv => `
${inv.invoice_id || inv.name}
${inv.customer || '-'}
₹${inv.grand_total_inr || 0}

${inv.app_name || '-'}

${inv.package_name || '-'}

${inv.package_type || '-'}

${inv.duration || 0} Days

${inv.email_id || '-'}

${inv.site || '-'}

₹${inv.total || 0}

₹${inv.grand_total_inr || 0}

₹${inv.rounded_total_inr || 0}

₹${inv.discount_amount || 0}

`).join(''); content.innerHTML = `
${html}
`; }
